chunks: "Handle your major affairs personally, and entrust what is small among them to someone else."
Then it was said: "What kind of thing?" He said: "The purchase transactions of real estate and what resembles them."

key_terms.أَشْرِيَةِ: purchase transactions or acts of buying

ai.seo_question: Which matters should a person handle personally according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام teaches that a person should personally oversee important matters and delegate minor ones. The hadith illustrates this with significant property transactions and similar dealings, emphasizing careful personal involvement in consequential affairs.
